text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis and basophilia, mild hypoglycemia, elevated creatinine, and hyperchloremia. These findings suggest possible acute or chronic hypoxic and/or infectious/inflammatory processes, with evidence of bone marrow suppression or dysfunction and impaired renal function. Immediate clinical correlation and further diagnostic workup are recommended.
